==Problem==

The year <imath>2002</imath> is a palindrome (a number that reads the same from left to right as it does from right to left). What is the product of the digits of the next year after <imath>2002</imath> that is a palindrome?

<imath>\textbf{(A)}\ 0 \qquad \textbf{(B)}\ 4 \qquad \textbf{(C)}\ 9 \qquad \textbf{(D)}\ 16 \qquad \textbf{(E)}\ 25</imath>

==Solution==

The next palindrome is <imath>2112</imath>, so the answer is <imath>2 \cdot 1 \cdot 1 \cdot 2 = \boxed{\textbf{(B)}\ 4}</imath>.
